threatModel.summary: Decision Hub is a tenant-scoped, fail-closed decision-support and evidence system. Its core objectives are exact tenant/environment provenance, bounded and transactionally coherent evidence, audit integrity, secret protection, and prevention of trading or mutable-learning side effects.
